description: This file defines a high-level QA service class that handles answering questions either via local logic or delegated to an MCP server. It includes method implementations for answering questions, invoking MCP tools, and managing fallback logic.

classes.name: QAService
classes.description: A high-level service class providing question-answering functionalities, selecting between local responses and MCP-based responses.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the QAService instance with an MCPClient.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _local_answer(self, question: str, context: Optional[str])
methods.description: Provides a basic placeholder answer locally, optionally including context information.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] answer( self, question: str, context: Optional[str] = None, use_mcp: bool = False )
methods.description: Answers a question either locally or via MCP, based on the 'use_mcp' parameter, with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] invoke_mcp_tool(self, tool: str, arguments: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], timeout: Optional[int])
methods.description: Invokes a specified MCP tool with arguments and timeout, returning a standardized response or error.
